title: Recursive patterns
description:
Solve small problems with recursion.

```
factorial(10) = 3628800
fib(20) = 6765
sum of nested {1, {2, 3}, {{4}}} = 10
flatten -> 1 2 3 4
```

starter.main.lua:
local function factorial(n)
  return 1
end

local function nested_sum(t)
  return 0
end

print("factorial(10) =", factorial(10))
print("sum of nested =", nested_sum({ 1, { 2, 3 }, { { 4 } } }))

hints: `nested_sum`: for each value, if `type(v) == "table"` add `nested_sum(v)`, otherwise add `v` (lesson 3.04).
`flatten(t, out)` creates `out = out or {}` and passes the same `out` down, returning it at the end.
requirements: `nested_sum(t)` adds numbers in tables inside tables, any depth.
`flatten(t, out)` collects them into one list.
stretch: Print every way to make 10 from the coins 1, 2 and 5.
